verdict.rationale: An in-console AI assistant that surfaces insights from usage or workload data is a plausible capability for a GPU cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents raw infrastructure: instances, clusters, JupyterLab, a Grafana GPU dashboard and the usage page. None of it is AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product, and a self-hosted notebook or dashboard is a user-side tool rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
